findings.current: Calling S-rank Hunters here—the core of our forces—would put everyone left behind in danger.
findings.defect: The source uses the singular S-rank Hunter; the plural adds a quantity the Korean does not establish.
findings.rationale: The Korean says “S급 헌터를” and describes that Hunter as a core part of the force. The accepted baseline also preserves the singular.
findings.replacement: Calling an S-rank Hunter here—a key part of our strength—would put everyone left behind in danger.

summary: One minor quantity shift: the source refers to calling an S-rank Hunter, while the assembled English makes it plural.
